title: Handoff 16 makhluk nama besar — 7 Oktober 2026

receipts.name: Sun Wukong

visual_requirements.description: One living furry macaque with projecting muzzle, monkey nose and ears, one head and two visible arms; normal two-legged anatomy intended, with legs outside the half-body crop.
Gold Buddhist head circlet and one continuous black iron staff with gold bands at both ends; no inscription.

Threatening intense expression, battle dust, flying stone fragments and localized physical sparks where the staff scrapes a stone edge. Contact sparks are an artistic physical consequence of battle, not a claimed magical power.

Dark ruined palace battle surroundings evoke Wukong's fighting and havoc in heaven; the circlet-wearing portrait and palace context form an illustrative composite rather than a precise chronological reconstruction.

receipts.depicted_variant: Half-body fierce living macaque Sun Wukong, twisting with one black iron staff; both gold-banded ends visible, one end scraping stone with localized physical sparks and battle dust.
receipts.main_visual_notes: Main agent inspected native PNG B directly: intense threatening macaque gaze, one head, two distinct arms and gripping hands, gold circlet, one readable black iron staff with both gold ends; localized sparks at stone contact and battle dust. Opaque cloth. Legs below portrait crop cannot be counted. No visible text, watermark, glowing eye aura or added magic.

receipts.name: Shiva

visual_requirements.description: One human head, two arms and two legs; two normal eyes plus third forehead eye, crescent in matted topknot, physical Vasuki at neck, trident and damaru.
Distinct blue throat and tiger-skin outer garment; opaque modest drapery covers torso and lower body.
Directed flame visibly issuing from third forehead eye.
Ganga visibly cascades from matted topknot, physically distinct from fire.
Rocky snowy Kailasa mountain abode.

receipts.depicted_variant: Two-armed, one-headed Shiva the serene Protector on Kailasa with third-eye fire and the Ganga flowing from his matted topknot.
receipts.main_visual_notes: Main agent viewed native PNG directly: monumental respectful Shiva on snowy rocks, one head and two visible clothed legs; two coherent arms hold a three-pronged trident and hourglass drum. Distinct blue throat, physical cobra at neck, crescent on topknot, tiger outer wrap. Fire visibly starts at central forehead third-eye location and Ganga flows down from matted hair; these reference c20 and c05/c19 respectively. No visible text, watermark, nudity or extra arms. Two-arm arrangement and simultaneous iconographic effects are editorial composition rather than a fixed textual arm count or single episode.

receipts.name: Zeus

visual_requirements.description: Regal mature dark-bearded man with one head, two arms, two legs; lightning held like javelin, royal sceptre and eagle.
Strong lightning and monumental storm clouds express sky and weather dominion.
Olympus mountain scale beneath the king of gods.

receipts.depicted_variant: Regal mature dark-bearded Zeus above Olympus, grasping lightning javelin and royal sceptre with eagle.
receipts.main_visual_notes: Main agent viewed native PNG directly: one mature dark-bearded Zeus, two distinct arms holding lightning and a royal sceptre, two sandal-clad feet, one living eagle on rocks. Strong lightning crosses storm clouds, Olympus mountain landscape and low viewpoint give monumental presence. Torso and pelvis covered by opaque robes; no text, watermark, gore, extra limbs or magical anatomy. Decorative sceptre finial is an object ornament. c02/c09/c12/c21 support attributes and weather effects.

receipts.name: Dragon

visual_requirements.description: One lithe serpentine dragon with one head, two natural eyes, four clearly separate clawed legs, horns, carp scales, ox ears, camel forehead, eagle claws and tiger-like paw pads; no wings.
Heavy rain and atmospheric lightning accompany the dragon's flight over water.
Water source and cloud habitat; majestic benevolent presence.

receipts.depicted_variant: Chinese four-legged horned wingless rain-dragon of the Lung-Wang tradition
receipts.main_visual_notes: Main agent viewed native PNG directly: one enormous wingless serpentine Chinese dragon with a single head, branching stag antlers, ox-like ears, carp-like scales and exactly four separated clawed legs. Near eye visible and far eye occluded. Rain and lightning surround flight over a river and small settlement, supported by c02/c07/c11; four legs and horns by c16. No fire, wings, text, watermark, gore or victims. Paw-pad texture is too small to fully inspect; settlement design and perspective are artistic choices.

receipts.name: Vishnu

visual_requirements.description: One human head, two eyes, four coherent arms and two legs; blue coloration, one separate discus/conch/mace/lotus in each hand.
Strong warm solar radiance, with the golden discus visually illuminated.
Shining golden jeweled Vaikuntha on Mount Meru above lotus lakes.

receipts.depicted_variant: Four-armed blue Vishnu holding discus, conch, mace and lotus in shining Vaikuntha, with solar radiance.
receipts.main_visual_notes: Main agent viewed final native PNG directly: blue Vishnu with one head, natural eyes and four distinct arms holding one discus, conch, mace and lotus. Torso now covered by opaque high-neck gold garment; opaque lower drapery covers legs, with a foreground blue foot visible. Gold celestial city and lotus lake accompany warm radiance supported by Vaikuntha and solar-association claims c13/c22/c23; radiance is iconographic interpretation, not a claimed ray attack. Body, four-hand attributes and respectful monumental presence are readable. No visible text, watermark or extra limbs; leg geometry partly hidden by long drapery.

receipts.name: Krishna

visual_requirements.description: Youthful dark blue-black Krishna with peacock feather and yellow robe; one head, two arms and two legs in the single familiar Krishna form.
Govardhan held up with one hand, sheltering his community from catastrophic rain; the rain is external rather than emitted power.
Hill lifted clear of ground with a protected dry shelter, small cattle and storm rain beyond.

receipts.depicted_variant: Blue-black Krishna in yellow opaque robe and peacock feather, holding Govardhan Hill in one hand during torrential rain.
receipts.main_visual_notes: Main agent viewed native PNG directly: one youthful dark blue-black Krishna with a peacock feather and fully opaque yellow garments; two arms and two bare feet visible. One raised hand visibly supports the underside of Govardhan while his other hand extends toward the protected community and cattle. Storm rain falls beyond the hill and dry shelter; rain belongs to the deluge sent by Indra, not an invented Krishna power (c05/c18/c31). Strong low-angle monumental scale, no visible text, watermark, extra limbs or nudity. Raised palm/fingers partly occluded at rock contact; tiny background people are not individually inspectable.

receipts.name: Apollo

visual_requirements.description: One handsome beardless long-haired youthful adult man, human anatomy, clothed; silver bow, tortoiseshell lyre and bronze sacrificial tripod.
Strong warm divine light to represent Apollo's documented light domain; no solar fire or claim of literal Helios identity.
Monumental Greek sanctuary of Delphi and oracle tripod.

receipts.depicted_variant: Apollo as the youthful beardless long-haired god of light, music and Delphi, with silver bow, tortoiseshell lyre and oracle tripod
receipts.main_visual_notes: Main agent viewed native PNG directly: youthful beardless long-haired Apollo in an opaque long chiton, two arms holding a silver bow and tortoiseshell-pattern lyre, two sandal-clad feet. Bronze offering tripod and monumental Delphi-like temple architecture are visible. Warm broad light beams interpret documented light domain c01; no solar weapon, disk or Helios chariot. Ordinary offering smoke and sanctuary layout are artistic staging. No visible text, watermark, extra limbs, gore or nudity; small decorative details are not independently authenticated archaeology.

receipts.name: Athena

visual_requirements.description: Stately human woman, one head, two arms/two legs and two eyes; long opaque robe, crested helm, shield and spear.
Snake-trimmed aegis with sculptural non-gory Gorgon face ornament.
Acropolis temple, olive tree and natural owl, her documented setting and symbols.
Wind-driven rain clouds and rough sea illustrate her documented sea-storm action.

receipts.depicted_variant: Living Athena the stately armored defender above the Athenian Acropolis and coast, with a documented sea storm behind her.
receipts.main_visual_notes: Main agent viewed native PNG directly: a stately Athena with one head and crested helmet, spear in one arm and coherent shield-bearing side; shield hand and lower legs hidden behind shield/opaque long robes. Snake-trimmed aegis and non-gory Gorgon face relief, natural owl, olive tree and Acropolis architecture are visible. Dark rain clouds and rough sea illustrate storm action c25, with no lightning. Strong majestic low-angle presence, no visible text, watermark or extra limbs. Athens setting and Trojan sea-storm power form an explicitly artistic iconographic tableau rather than a reconstructed single event.

receipts.name: Brahma

visual_requirements.description: Exactly four cardinal heads, four arms, golden bearded complexion; no weapons; symbols of knowledge and creation.
Lotus seat above primordial waters.
Sun-bright golden egg divides into two halves forming heaven and earth with waters.

receipts.depicted_variant: Golden four-headed, four-armed bearded Brahma on lotus, in the split cosmic golden egg cosmogony.
receipts.main_visual_notes: Main agent viewed corrected native PNG directly: exactly four separate crowned heads, front and both side faces bearded with the rear head facing away; four coherent arms with three open palms and one blank closed manuscript, no weapons. Opaque gold tunic and cloth over folded legs; lotus seat above water, two large gold shell arcs framing heaven and earth. Egg-creation visualization supported by c42/c43 and body counts by c03/c19. No added galaxies or planets, text, watermark, gore or nudity. Rear face and folded leg details are occluded; manuscript interprets knowledge symbols, with no invented readable scripture.

receipts.name: Aphrodite

visual_requirements.description: One beautiful adult woman in opaque garments and elaborately embroidered chest band/girdle; sacred dove and myrtle wreath identify her.
Sea foam recalls the documented foam-born emergence; embroidered band represents love power without invented beams.
Sea-shore approach to Cyprus; scallop-shell attribute.

receipts.depicted_variant: Foam-born Aphrodite approaching Cyprus, clothed in the Archaic/Classical manner with embroidered girdle and sacred dove
receipts.main_visual_notes: Main agent viewed corrected native PNG directly: one fully clothed Aphrodite with two arms/hands and two visible feet, a white dove on one hand, leafy flowering wreath, scallop shell and foamy shore. Broad embroidered physical band now crosses her chest diagonally, matching c48; the foam recalls foam-born emergence c34/c50, without implying ocean-control or invented love beams. Low viewpoint and natural warm sky support majestic presence. No visible text, watermark, extra humanoids, nudity or gore. Wreath species and shoreline architecture remain illustrative, not botanical or archaeological verification.

receipts.name: Gabriel

visual_requirements.description: Human male form with opaque linen garment; one head, two arms, two legs and two natural eyes.
Wings accompany human form, one visible pair as editorial arrangement; not Islamic six-hundred-wing variant.
Swift airborne posture expresses documented flight.
Strong physical flame plumes behind figure express documented Jewish prince-of-fire association.
Earth below descending messenger, original evening rocky landscape.

receipts.depicted_variant: Jewish Gabriel in the form of a linen-clothed man with wings, flying as divine messenger and prince of fire.
receipts.main_visual_notes: Main agent viewed native PNG directly: one calm male Gabriel, two arms/open hands and two bare feet beneath fully opaque high-neck layered linen, with two large white feather wings and visible bases. He flies above an evening rocky landscape amid a powerful flame backdrop. The selected Jewish Encyclopedia tradition documents male linen form c12, wings/flight c14/c19 and prince-of-fire association c13. One pair and feather material are explicitly artistic choices where that tradition specifies no count; no mixing with six-hundred-wing Islamic depiction or unsourced trumpet. No visible text, watermark, weapons, burning clothes, gore or nudity. Wingtips cropped at upper corners; no claim that this precise fiery descent occurred.

receipts.name: Satan

visual_requirements.description: Single humanoid in historical Christian art appearance with horns, unusually hairy lower legs, cloven hooves and one tail; no wings or dragon anatomy.
Wilderness relates to the Christian temptation setting; gesture expresses temptation without depicting another religious figure.

receipts.depicted_variant: Satan in medieval Christian art iconography: horned humanoid with hairy legs, cloven hooves and tail, fully clothed and without wings or emitted fire.
receipts.main_visual_notes: Main agent viewed native PNG directly: one menacing humanoid Satan in the explicit historical Christian-art variant of c24; two horns, two non-glowing eyes, two visible hands, two hairy lower legs ending in clearly cloven hooves, and one tail. Torso and upper legs covered by opaque dark tunic/cape. Wilderness setting and coaxing hand recall temptation (c01/c15). No wings, fire, supernatural aura, text, watermark or gore. Tail attachment hidden by cloth; ears, beard and dark palette are artistic styling. The art appearance is not asserted to be a Biblical anatomical description.

receipts.name: Hera

visual_requirements.description: One noble adult woman, crowned and bridal-veiled, fully clothed, seated on a golden throne, holding lotus-tipped sceptre and pomegranate.
Star-filled sky expresses her sky/stars domain without invented lightning or energy beams.
Greek sanctuary setting recalling Argos/Mycenae and golden throne iconography.

receipts.depicted_variant: Dignified crowned and veiled Hera on a golden throne with lotus-tipped royal sceptre and pomegranate beneath the starry sky
receipts.main_visual_notes: Main agent viewed native PNG directly: one dignified crowned and bridal-veiled Hera enthroned in fully opaque ivory/blue robes, two hands holding a lotus-tipped sceptre and a pomegranate, one sandal-clad foot visible while the other is concealed. Gold throne and starry sky express queen/sky domain c02/c04/c08/c21/c31. Cloth star embroidery and throne animal reliefs are decoration. No visible lightning, energy beams, extra limbs, text, watermark, gore or nudity. Sanctuary and crown design are illustrative, not exact archaeological reconstructions.

receipts.name: Poseidon

visual_requirements.description: One-headed mature bearded dark-haired human deity, two arms/two legs and two eyes; no fish tail.
Three-pronged trident, one coherent hand holding it and other hand empty.
Gathering storm clouds, violent sea waves and spray.
Trident striking ground with fractured coastal rock and fragments, illustrating earthquake/rock-shattering ability.

receipts.depicted_variant: Mature dark-haired bearded human Poseidon commanding a stormy sea and striking coastal rock with his three-pronged trident.
receipts.main_visual_notes: Main agent viewed native PNG directly: one mature dark-haired bearded Poseidon, two coherent visible arms; one holds a trident with exactly three tines and its shaft contacts coastal rock. Opaque green tunic/drapery covers torso and lower body; legs and feet concealed. Huge waves, spray and gathering storm clouds express sea-storm powers c06/c17, with small loose rock fragments near the shaft illustrating ground-striking/rock-shattering c15/c35. No lightning, fish tail, text, watermark, extra arms, nudity or gore. Rock fracture itself is subtle under spray; small boat is an artistic scale cue.

receipts.name: Artemis

visual_requirements.description: Familiar young adult maiden huntress with bow and quiver, one head/two arms/two legs, excluding early winged and Ephesian variants.
Golden bow physically drawn for the hunt, not a magical arrow beam; documented extraordinary huntress and mistress of wild animals.
Forests, shadowy hills and windy mountain peaks; one natural deer as sacred animal.

receipts.depicted_variant: Unwinged classical maiden huntress Artemis drawing her golden bow above shadowy forested hills and windy peaks, with quiver and deer.
receipts.main_visual_notes: Main agent viewed native PNG directly: one unwinged maiden Artemis, two distinct arms and two legs/feet, modest opaque cream tunic and green windblown cloak. She physically draws a gold bow with one feathered arrow; quiver visible, natural deer beside her, and immense forest/mountain landscape below. Hunting action and windy peaks follow c21/c37, with no invented lunar magic or emitted energy. No visible text, watermark, victims, gore or extra limbs. Upper bow tip cropped; deer rear legs overlap and cannot all be counted independently.

receipts.name: Venus

visual_requirements.description: One beautiful adult goddess with natural human anatomy in fully opaque garments; modest respectful portrayal of love/fertility goddess.
One tapering altar flame represents the favourable flame omen, and one bright evening star signifies Venus's celestial guiding form; no invented spell beam.
Monumental Roman sanctuary setting presents Venus as protective mother of Roman state, with distant ships recalling Aeneas's guidance.

receipts.depicted_variant: Fully clothed Venus as the protective mother of Rome, with evening-star emblem and a tapering altar flame recalling the favourable Pygmalion omen
receipts.main_visual_notes: Main agent viewed native PNG directly: one noble living Venus with two normal hands and two sandal-clad feet, fully opaque ivory tunic and burgundy mantle. Open palm beside a bronze bowl; tapering flame clearly begins at the bowl, not her fingers. One bright evening star above distant ships, source-grounded by celestial guiding form c19 and favourable flame omen c22. Roman protective-mother setting is an emblematic combination (c02/c12/c18), distinct from Aphrodite foam/dove/shell depiction. No visible text, watermark, body-energy beams, extra limbs, gore or nudity. Gold hair ornament and architecture are artistic decoration; a still image cannot establish three sequential fire ignitions or actual historical festival location.
